corrective_action: Any required-arm refusal now writes an atomic receipt with seed, objective, reason, and last-good checkpoint, then aborts both loops. Unexpected exceptions write an atomic crash receipt and re-raise. Failure-injection tests cover both paths. No checkpoint from this run may be reused.
